cs.t: I've used a 43-inch 4k monitor for 4 years.  First a Samsung and now a TCL.   I love it.  Some people worry about frame latency for high performance gaming, but that's not me.  It handles my level of PC gaming just fine, in addition to being my programming workhorse.
cs.th: Dell’s new UltraSharp monitor is a 6K powerhouse for pros
